exposure: Use of oxytocin decision support checklist
checklist integration into the electronic medical record (EMR)
cohort: Patients with singleton gestations at 37 weeks or greater who received oxytocin during labor from October 2012 to February 2017 at an integrated community health care system
finding: The use of an oxytocin decision support checklist was associated with decreased oxytocin use patterns but also with longer labor times.
mod_finding: While the rates of cesarean delivery were similar between groups using an oxytocin checklist and those who did not, analysis stratified by mode of delivery showed oxytocin checklist use was associated with longer labors.
